skill.name: baoyu-post-to-x
skill.description: Automate composing X posts and long-form X Articles from text, Markdown, and local images using Chrome browser automation.
skill.summary: Compose and optionally publish X posts and X Articles through a real Chrome session.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: The skill is a real X publishing automation tool, but it has substantial security-sensitive behavior: child processes, Chrome DevTools control of a logged-in browser, clipboard writes, and OS-level paste keystrokes. Many static findings are formatting false positives, but the confirmed behavior warrants strong warnings and review before installation.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before sending paste keystrokes, clearly show the target application, and avoid running when the target window is not verified.
Remove bypass language and automation-detection disabling unless it is necessary and allowed by the target platform terms.
Escape or strictly allowlist application names before interpolating them into AppleScript.

remediation.issue: Persistent browser profile contains login state
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated automation profile and document how to delete or rotate it after use.
Prefer direct platform APIs where possible and keep command arguments fixed or allowlisted.

content.user_title: Publish Posts and Articles to X
content.value_statement: Posting rich content to X can require repetitive browser steps and format conversion. This skill automates drafts, images, and Markdown articles through Chrome while keeping preview mode as the default.
actual_capabilities: Composes regular X posts with text and up to four local images.
Converts Markdown articles into HTML suitable for X Articles.
Uploads cover images and content images through the X article editor.
Runs Chrome with a persistent profile so users can log in once.
Supports preview or draft mode by default, with explicit submit options.
Copies image and HTML content to the system clipboard for browser paste workflows.
limitations: Requires Google Chrome or a compatible Chromium browser on the local machine.
Requires the user to be logged in to X, and X Articles may require X Premium.
Uses OS clipboard and keyboard automation, which can affect the active desktop session.
May break if X changes its page structure, selectors, or anti-automation behavior.

use_cases.title: Publish campaign posts
use_cases.description: Prepare text and image posts for launch announcements or marketing updates with preview before posting.

use_cases.title: Draft long-form articles
use_cases.description: Convert Markdown drafts into X Articles and place cover or inline images into the editor.

use_cases.title: Automate social publishing tests
use_cases.description: Validate how content appears in a real Chrome session before manually approving publication.

prompt_templates.title: Create a preview post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft an X post in preview mode with this text: <your post text>.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a post with images
prompt_templates.scenario: Add media to a regular post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compose an X post with this text and these image paths: <text>, <image paths>. Keep it in preview mode.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Markdown article
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert and draft an X Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an X Article draft from <markdown file>. Use <cover image path> as the cover image.

prompt_templates.title: Review then publish
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft the post from <content>. Show me the preview state first, then publish only after I confirm.

output_examples.input: Draft a short launch post with one screenshot.
output_examples.output: The skill opens Chrome, fills the X composer, attaches the screenshot, and leaves the post in preview mode.

output_examples.input: Create an X Article from a Markdown file.
output_examples.output: The skill converts the Markdown, opens the X Articles editor, inserts the title, content, and images, then leaves a draft for review.

output_examples.input: Publish a prepared post after confirmation.
output_examples.output: The skill uses the submit option to click the post or publish button after the user explicitly requests publishing.

best_practices: Always run in preview or draft mode before using submit or publish options.
Use a dedicated Chrome profile for X automation to limit account and session exposure.
Keep image paths local and verify clipboard contents before publishing sensitive media.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill on a shared desktop session with unrelated applications in focus.
Do not use it to bypass platform rules, spam limits, or consent requirements.
Do not publish sensitive drafts without manual review in the browser.

faq.question: Does this skill post automatically?
faq.answer: Preview and draft modes are the default. Posting or publishing requires the submit option.

faq.question: Does it require an X login?
faq.answer: Yes. The first run opens Chrome so the user can log in, and the profile can save the session.

faq.question: Can it publish X Articles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft and publish Markdown-based X Articles, but X Articles may require X Premium.

faq.question: Does it support images?
faq.answer: Yes. Regular posts support up to four images, and articles support cover and inline images.

faq.question: Why does it use clipboard automation?
faq.answer: The scripts use the system clipboard and paste events because browser file and rich text workflows can reject synthetic events.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Users should review the OS command, clipboard, browser automation, and anti-automation bypass behavior before use.
